english.note: Use 激將法 specifically when someone provokes or challenges another person in order to make them do something.
Use this for a deliberate provocation meant to make someone do something they would otherwise avoid.

examples.english: Saying I didn’t dare go on stage alone was just provocation.
examples.traditional: 佢話我唔敢一個人上台，其實只係用激將法。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 waa6 ngo5 m4 gam2 jat1 go3 jan4 soeng5 toi1 kei4 sat6 zi2 hai6 jung6 gik1 zoeng3 faat3

examples.english: They used a challenge to say I didn't dare join, and got me to sign up right away.
examples.traditional: 佢用激將法話我唔敢落場，搞到我即刻報名。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 jung6 gik1 zoeng3 faat3 waa6 ngo5 m4 gam2 lok6 coeng4 gaau2 dou2 ngo5 zik1 hak1 bou3 meng2
